title: Topologic: Revolver's Deck (lore build)
summary: Topologic is five Link Monsters with no Main Deck, so this list uses the deck of the duelist who wields them in VRAINS: Revolver, leader of the Knights of Hanoi. His Skill, Storm Access, pulls a Topologic from the Data Storm, and the rest of his deck is real Rokket and DARK Dragon cards.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: The Rokkets: his cannon fodder. They destroy themselves when a Link targets them, then call the next Rokket in the End Phase.
Cracking Dragon, the Knights of Hanoi's signature monster, plus Gateway Dragon and Sniffer Dragon from his early duels.
Mirror Force and Mirror Force Launcher, the old Traps he leans on against Playmaker.
Extra Deck: Topologic Bomber Dragon, Trisbaena and Zeroboros, his ace Borreload Dragon and its family, Twin Triangle Dragon and the other DARK Dragon Links he used.

summary.title: How it plays
points: Quick Launch and Absorouter Dragon fill the field with Rokkets. Two Rokkets make Twin Triangle, Booster or Quadborrel, whose effects target Rokkets and set them off.

Topologic Bomber Dragon wipes every Main Monster Zone the moment a monster is summoned where a Link points. Trisbaena banishes the arrivals and all Spells/Traps, and Zeroboros banishes the whole field.
Borreload Dragon and Borrelsword Dragon finish games, and Borrelguard Dragon brings back a destroyed monster.
Topologic Gumblar Dragon, the Topologic he used for his Extra Link lock, is Forbidden, and the anime-only cards are left out.

main: Summons itself next to a Rokket; searches a Rokket monster when sent to the GY.
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to send a monster to the GY; calls a Rokket at the End Phase.
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself and their cards in its column; calls a Rokket at the End Phase.
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to send a Spell/Trap to the GY; calls a Rokket.
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to banish from their Extra Deck; calls a Rokket.
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself and a monster with its neighbours; calls a Rokket.
Targeted by a Link: destroys itself to stop and negate a monster; calls a Rokket.
Revives a different DARK monster when your Extra Deck DARK monster falls.
The Knights of Hanoi's dragon: shrinks and burns each lone monster they summon.
Summons itself when they have a Link; calls a small DARK Dragon from the hand.
Searches another Sniffer Dragon; cheap Link material.
Quick-Play: summons a Rokket from the Deck.
Field Spell: summons two Rokkets from the hand or GY.
Destroys your Rokket to draw two, setting it off.
Revives a Rokket as an equip; draws when it falls.
Fetches Mirror Force; resets both when destroyed.
extra: Topologic Bomber Dragon
Link-4: wipes the Main Monster Zones when a monster lands where a Link points.
Topologic Trisbaena
Link-3: banishes arrivals in its zones and all Spells/Traps, with burn.
Topologic Zeroboros
Link-4: banishes the whole field, then returns.
Borreload Dragon
Link-4: shrinks a monster with no response; steals what it attacks.
Borrelsword Dragon
Link-4: attacks twice and halves what it hits.
Borrelguard Dragon
Link-4: can't be destroyed by effects; revives a destroyed monster.
Twin Triangle Dragon
Link-2 of two small Dragons: revives a Level 5+ monster.
Booster Dragon
Link-2 of two Rokkets: pumps a monster; revives a Dragon when it falls.
Quadborrel Dragon
Link-2: destroys a monster; revives Rokkets if it was a Link.
Triple Burst Dragon
Link-3: negates in the Damage Step; brings back a small Link.
Vorticular Drumgon
Link-3 of three DARK Dragons: draws when summoned.
Borreload eXcharge Dragon
Rank 4 for two DARK Dragons: shrinks a monster and revives a Borrel.
Dillingerous Dragon
Link-2 for DARK Dragons: revives itself when a Rokket arrives.
